segments.text: 31 And at the end of theſe dayes I Nebuchadnezer lift vp myne eyes vnto heauen and myne vnderſtādyng was reſtored vnto me, and I gaue thankes vnto the moſt high, and I prayſed and honored him that liueth for euer, whoſe power is an euerlaſtyng power and his kingdome is from generation to generation.
